hypothesis: Archetype: allocator / accumulator refactor plus common-case split. _StringGlobber.scandir() currently closes os.scandir() and then re-wraps each DirEntry in a generator of (entry, name, path) tuples, forcing per-entry tuple allocation and eager path fetches. A string-specific selector path that iterates raw DirEntry lists and computes name/path only when needed may preserve semantics while removing churn from recursive and wildcard globbing.
